$comment: The parts and art windows of each mockup in this folder, in mockup pixels: rectangles are [x, y, w, h]. `just ui-compare` crops each part from the mockup and from its replica (ui/src/replica/); a part's masks, and its mockup's masks where they overlap it, are blacked out of the difference image: the MAGIC card back's artwork, the mouse cursor. Art windows (`rect`, turned `rotate` degrees about its center, as on a tapped or fanned card) are cut out as the replicas' card art, named by slot (Card.tsx's SlotArt). The pixel-fidelity beads refine these, and keep each part's last reviewer verdict here, its accepted residuals and mockup conflicts and a fingerprint of the replica that passed (`just ui-verdict` writes them; tools/src/beryl_tools/verdicts.py).
